defects.why: A stale builder provenance note from a different PR head could be accepted by a fresh validator.
Tampered embedded builder artifacts could survive the fresh-validator handoff.
Production validation could silently bypass 21-claim spine closure and emit only the legacy Evidence Bundle.
Merge authorization could proceed even though the canonical evidence spine never reached global 100 percent completion.
A bundle compiled against a weaker or stale evidence policy could authorize merge.
